annotations.title: Get the booking link for an empty leg flight

description: Return the SkyAccess booking page link for a specific empty leg flight, for handing to a customer so they can review and book it themselves. This is read-only: it does not create, hold, modify or cancel any booking, and no booking exists until the customer completes it on the page. Use request_booking instead if the customer wants a specialist to contact them.

flightId.description: The flight id returned in the `flightId` field of a search_empty_legs result
